title: Dimension of the closure of an image point
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $a:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $f:X\to Y$ be locally finite type morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For every $x\in X$, their topological Krull dimensions [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] satisfy $\dim\overline{\{f(x)\}}\leq\dim\overline{\{x\}}$. Neither quasi-compactness nor irreducibility is required.

proof.text: Use the existing proved source-library theorem attached to this node. Its proof chooses, near each specialization z of f(x), an affine open V containing both z and f(x), and an affine neighbourhood U of x mapping into V. The affine ring map induces an injection from the quotient domain corresponding to f(x) into the quotient domain corresponding to x. Dimensions of finite type domains over k equal their transcendence degrees, so this injection gives the dimension inequality on these affine opens. An open embedding preserves the dimension of the trace of a point closure on its range. The source trace has dimension at most the full source-point closure by subspace monotonicity. The affine opens V cover the image-point closure, so the open-cover dimension bound proves the result. This attaches an existing fully proved declaration; it adds no Lean obligation.
